description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for the analytics overview endpoint in a Node.js backend. It sets up routes for HTTP methods to serve dashboard overview metrics, applying middleware for authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: head /overview
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests to /overview, returns headers indicating endpoint info without response body.

methods.name: options /overview
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests to /overview, responds with status 204.

methods.name: get /overview
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /overview, retrieves overview metrics via the overviewMetrics controller function.
